lead.headline: Johnson steps aside as House GOP leader after midterm losses
lead.dek: Scalise and Jordan seek the post before a Nov. 10 vote; Trump weighs Hegseth's future, sources say
body: House Speaker Mike Johnson told staff on a call Wednesday that he will not run for Republican leader in the new Congress, a day after Democrats won the House and Senate, a source familiar with his plans told CBS News and NPR. Johnson, R-La., had said in October he intended to stay on as leader if Republicans lost the majority.

House Majority Leader Steve Scalise sent colleagues a five-page letter Wednesday saying his "number one goal as Republican Leader will be to win back the majority," and Judiciary Chairman Jim Jordan wrote a two-page letter calling himself "battle-tested on the oversight front," CBS News reported. House Republicans hold leadership elections Nov. 10, a GOP aide said.

The losses reached the Pentagon as well. Trump has asked advisers whether Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth should stay, CBS News reported, citing multiple sources, and NBC News reported, citing two people, that Trump told allies he is weighing replacements. Trump said Hegseth is "doing a very good job"; Vice President JD Vance wrote on X, "The reason we lost is the war."

briefs.headline: Mississippi Senate race heads to extended count, 65 votes apart
briefs.summary: Democrat Scott Colom led Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith by 65 votes in NBC's count at 5:20 p.m. Wednesday, with thousands of mail and affidavit ballots left. Counties report by Nov. 13; the state has no recount law.

briefs.headline: Indiana executes Weisheit, first of 3 U.S. executions set Thursday
briefs.summary: Jeffrey Weisheit, 50, was pronounced dead at 12:45 a.m. for a 2010 arson that killed his girlfriend's children, 8 and 5. Florida and Alabama plan executions later Thursday.

briefs.headline: Dow jumps nearly 1,600 points, its biggest gain of the year
briefs.summary: The Dow rose 3% Wednesday and the S&P 500 climbed 1.6% to 7,689 after the midterms. Analysts cited the end of election uncertainty; Trump Media fell nearly 25%.

briefs.headline: Shooting at Citi complex near Tampa leaves 2 dead, including gunman
briefs.summary: Hillsborough County Sheriff Chad Chronister called Wednesday's shooting at Citibank's office complex in Brandon, Fla., "a targeted incident." More than 360 deputies responded.

briefs.headline: IRGC says 2 tankers and a tugboat burn in Hormuz as Trump defends war
briefs.summary: The Revolutionary Guard said a tanker hit a mine on an "illegal passageway" and a tugboat burned beside a supertanker, AFP reported, citing Fars. Trump called the war's role in GOP losses "largely true."

briefs.headline: Hong Kong court gives Joshua Wong 10 more years for collusion
briefs.summary: The High Court sentenced the 30-year-old activist Thursday under the national security law for lobbying for U.S. sanctions, cutting a 13-year starting point for his guilty plea.

briefs.headline: Kyiv goes more than 24 hours without water after energy strikes
briefs.summary: Tuesday's Russian strikes on the grid cut pumping across most of the capital in what a government adviser called the worst water outage of the war; the utility said supply stabilized Wednesday afternoon.

briefs.headline: Bukele posts videos of Salvadoran troops fighting Haiti's gangs
briefs.summary: El Salvador has sent more than 2,000 troops since four of its aviation technicians vanished Oct. 18; a UN spokesman said only about 200 fall under the UN-backed Gang Suppression Force.

briefs.headline: Smith claims 'clear mandate' as Democrats double House seats
briefs.summary: Senate President Randy Smith said Wednesday the GOP's 30-4 Senate majority is a "clear mandate" to continue its agenda; Democrats went from nine House seats to 21. GOP senators pick a president in December.

briefs.headline: Morrisey puts $3.2M into water filters for Mingo, McDowell
briefs.summary: The governor announced the program Wednesday: about $1.2M from a federal Rural Health Transformation grant and $2M from a contingency fund for countertop systems, well cleanings and replacement filters.

briefs.headline: Ex-Berkeley sheriff's office employee admits $3M fraud
briefs.summary: Lisa Lee French, 48, of Martinsburg pleaded guilty to a 2007-2024 scheme of more than 700 fraudulent transactions, federal prosecutors said; she agreed to pay $2,737,932 in restitution.

briefs.headline: PEIA proposes 2% premium increase for state workers
briefs.summary: The agency's Oct. 29 proposal raises state employee and teacher premiums 2%, the smallest increase since fiscal 2023, and local government premiums 4%; retirees pay the same. Hearings run Nov. 9-19.

regional.item: Democrat Tia Rumbaugh unseated Commissioner John Mandt Jr., and DuRon Jackson took the open Senate District 5 seat with 56%.
Kanawha County voters renewed the schools excess levy with 71%, funding 22% of the system's budget from 2029 to 2034.
Wirt County voters rejected a $9.3M school bond levy for a new high school 1,378 to 488, unofficial returns show.
Richwood voters renewed the city's municipal levies 217 to 159, and county turnout was 38% on 5,908 ballots.

away.item: Republican Rep. Mary Morrissey, in the House since 1997, lost her Bennington-5 seat Tuesday to Democrats Michael Nigro and Tom Blakely.

hotspots.item: Webster County beat Calhoun County 35-14 on Friday, Oct. 30, in its first home football game after four weeks on the road, The Webster Echo reported Sunday.
Topsail Beach put customers at 120-316 Bridgers Avenue under a boil water advisory Wednesday after fire hydrant maintenance dropped pressure, until samples clear.

briefs.headline: Bus crash south of Mackenzie sends about 20 to hospital
briefs.summary: A chartered shuttle bus went into a ditch on Highway 39 about 4 km south of Mackenzie, 160 km north of Prince George, at 9:10 a.m. Wednesday; injuries ranged from minor to serious, police said.

briefs.headline: Warriors tie it with 1.4 seconds left, beat Cougars in OT
briefs.summary: Mathieu Lajoie scored with 1.4 seconds left in regulation and again 55 seconds into overtime for a 3-2 Moose Jaw win at CN Centre. The Cougars (4-7-1-2) host Kelowna Friday and Saturday.

briefs.headline: WHL awards Chilliwack an expansion franchise
briefs.summary: The league grows to 24 teams with a club led by former Blackhawks coach Jeremy Colliton and ex-Canuck Mason Raymond. It will play at the 5,000-seat Chilliwack Coliseum starting in 2027-28.

briefs.headline: Champagne tables Carney's second budget Thursday afternoon
briefs.summary: The spring update pegged the 2026-27 deficit at $75B; the Parliamentary Budget Officer now projects about $63B. The document also sets immigration targets for the next two years.

briefs.headline: China extends tariff pause on canola meal, lobster to 2028
briefs.summary: Trade Minister Maninder Sidhu said Wednesday the March deal lifting Chinese tariffs on canola meal, peas, lobster and crab runs two more years. Canola seed exports to China are up 84% since March, he said.

briefs.headline: Astronauts set to install final ISS solar array today
briefs.summary: NASA's Anil Menon and CSA's Joshua Kutryk begin a seven-hour spacewalk at 8:30 a.m. ET to fit the eighth roll-out array, taking station power from 160 to about 215 kW.

briefs.headline: Durham study ties Industrial-era rickets to volcanic cooling
briefs.summary: Teeth from 21 people in a North Shields Quaker cemetery show dentin defects; 91 of 109 with known birth years were born within a decade of a major eruption.

briefs.headline: NYU Langone maps DNA sites that make tumors drug-sensitive
briefs.summary: Cutting the protein ESCO2 made colorectal, ovarian and lung cancer cells more sensitive to PARP inhibitors by piling folded DNA at a few sites, Nature Cell Biology reports.

briefs.headline: Study finds Nazi reactor needed up to 1,775 uranium cubes
briefs.summary: A PNAS Nexus study of two surviving cubes and archives says Heisenberg's 664-cube B8 pile needed 1,292 to 1,775 cubes and twice the heavy water Norway made in the whole war.

briefs.headline: Uber says only four rides were booked by AI agents in a week
briefs.summary: On its earnings call Wednesday, Uber said four rides and 500 Uber Eats orders came through AI agents in Halloween week, against about 320 million trips and orders.

briefs.headline: Michigan benchmark finds top AI agents fail 40% of cloud tasks
briefs.summary: On CloudOpsBench's 45 AWS tasks, Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.1 solved 60% and OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra 53%; about 80% of failures were reasoning errors, the Michigan team said.

briefs.headline: Sydney researchers find a mathematical limit to AI reproducibility
briefs.summary: Training about 500,000 neural networks, a Nature Machine Intelligence paper found a one-bit change in starting weights sent one image network to a different solution 48% of the time.

weather_ear: Thursday's forecast, from Jim Claudtore, lands at 7:15.
kicker: Summers-New River carries no regional line today; the Kyushu basho (tournament) opens Nov. 8 in Fukuoka, three days out.
